title: Container Bookings: cancellation fee ladder by tier
content:
## Scope
This ladder covers the Container Bookings product line and lists, for each tier, the per-container cancellation fee for each band of calendar days before the scheduled departure (ETD), and the most that cancellation fees may total on one booking.

## Bands and cap
- **14 or more days before ETD**: fee when cancelled 14 or more calendar days before ETD, USD per container.
- **7 to 13 days**: fee when cancelled 7 to 13 calendar days before ETD, USD per container.
- **3 to 6 days**: fee when cancelled 3 to 6 calendar days before ETD, USD per container.
- **0 to 2 days**: fee when cancelled 0 to 2 calendar days before ETD, USD per container.
- **Cap per booking**: the maximum total cancellation fee on one booking, USD per booking.

## Fee ladder
| Tier | 14 or more days | 7 to 13 days | 3 to 6 days | 0 to 2 days | Cap per booking |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Spot Saver | 150.00 | 250.00 | 350.00 | 450.00 | 2500.00 |
| AHL Spot Flex | 0.00 | 100.00 | 200.00 | 300.00 | 2000.00 |
| AHL Contract Booking | 0.00 | 0.00 | 100.00 | 200.00 | 1500.00 |
| AHL Contract Priority | 0.00 | 0.00 | 75.00 | 150.00 | 1200.00 |
| AHL Guaranteed Loading | 0.00 | 100.00 | 250.00 | 400.00 | 3000.00 |
| AHL Premium Express | 0.00 | 150.00 | 300.00 | 500.00 | 3000.00 |

All amounts are in USD.

## Points of judgement
**Which tier charges even a cancellation made 14 or more days ahead?** Only AHL Spot Saver, at 150.00 per container; the other five tiers are at 0.00 in that band.

**Which tiers still charge nothing at 7 to 13 days?** AHL Contract Booking and AHL Contract Priority.

**Where is the steepest late band?** AHL Premium Express, at 500.00 per container for 0 to 2 days before ETD.
